title: 1755: beyond Lisbon
hook: Was the tsunami’s reach confined to the damaged city?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: Local destruction and ocean-wide effects are different scales of the same event.

claims.text: 1 Nov 1755: Earthquake. An earthquake devastates Lisbon.
claims.source: https://sos.noaa.gov/catalog/datasets/tsunami-historical-series-lisbon-1755/ — NOAA description: Lisbon, Tagus, Cádiz, Safi and West Indies

claims.text: About 1 h later: Tagus. A tsunami surges into the estuary.
claims.source: https://sos.noaa.gov/catalog/datasets/tsunami-historical-series-lisbon-1755/ — NOAA description: Lisbon, Tagus, Cádiz, Safi and West Indies

claims.text: Later that day: Regional shores. Waves damage Spanish and Moroccan ports.
claims.source: https://sos.noaa.gov/catalog/datasets/tsunami-historical-series-lisbon-1755/ — NOAA description: Lisbon, Tagus, Cádiz, Safi and West Indies

claims.text: Later: Across the Atlantic. Observers report waves in the West Indies.
claims.source: https://sos.noaa.gov/catalog/datasets/tsunami-historical-series-lisbon-1755/ — NOAA description: Lisbon, Tagus, Cádiz, Safi and West Indies

claims.text: Local destruction and ocean-wide effects are different scales of the same event. Reports place tsunami impacts around Iberia and Morocco and across the Atlantic in the West Indies. This map shows selected observations; it does not calculate wave heights, arrival times or a precise source fault.
claims.source: https://sos.noaa.gov/catalog/datasets/tsunami-historical-series-lisbon-1755/ — NOAA description: Lisbon, Tagus, Cádiz, Safi and West Indies

claims.text: Later checkpoints group reports; their ordering is not a complete wave-arrival timetable.
